Subject: Upgradation of Road along with Drain at CW Hazaribagh (Jharkhand) – WO No. 3500001702 –
Provisional Extension of Time up to 30.11.2026 – reg.
Ref.: (i) LOA No. CWC RO-PAT0HoDE/7/2020-O/o HoD(Engineering)_PAT/LOA dt. 24.02.2026;
(ii) your application for extension of time dt. 19.10.2026;
Sir,
1. With reference to your application dt. 19.10.2026, the undersigned, as Engineer-in-Charge, hereby grants a
provisional (interim) extension of time for completion of the above work up to 30.11.2026 under Clause
5.4.1 of GCC. This extension is without prejudice to the right of the Corporation to levy compensation for delay
under Clause 2 of GCC.
2. The final extension of time and compensation, if any, shall be decided after completion of the work under Clause
5.4.1 of GCC, on analysis of excusable, concurrent and inexcusable delays as recorded in the Hindrance Register
(NIT Appendix T-II). You shall maintain the Hindrance Register at site with immediate effect, jointly signed by
the Engineers of the Corporation.
3. This provisional extension is subject to the following conditions:
(a) The validity of the Performance Guarantee (BG No. 6031IPEBG260016 dt. 27.02.2026), expiring on
10.11.2026, shall be extended through SFMS (MT767 COV) to cover the extended period plus 60 days, i.e.
up to 29.01.2027, before 10.11.2026 (Clause 1(II) of GCC), failing which the Performance Guarantee shall
be invoked (Clause 1(III)(a) of GCC).
(b) A revised programme shall be submitted within 03 days (Clause 5.4 of GCC), and the work shall be completed
by 30.11.2026.
(c) No extra or substituted item shall be executed without prior written approval of the Competent Authority
(Clause 12.2 of GCC).
(d) Contractor’s All Risk and Workmen Compensation policies (LOA para 7) shall be submitted immediately.
(e) The deficiencies pointed out vide this office letter dt. 03.11.2026 shall be rectified at your cost.
4. This provisional extension does not imply approval of your Deviation Statement, which shall be decided separately.
Yours faithfully,
(Kushagra Manash)
Sr. Manager (Engg.) / Engineer-in-Charge
